deadline.value: There is no fixed deadline for most schools, so applications are considered on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: There is no deadline to apply for research study for most Academic Schools at the University, but there are exceptions.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A supervisor must agree before a place or funding is allocated; agree a supervisor before applying.
supervisor.quote: no places or funding are allocated without the potential supervisor's agreement

funding.value: Most studentships are open to international students too, but the offer of a place does not guarantee funding.
funding.quote: The offer of a University place to undertake study or research does not carry with it the guarantee of financial support.

entry_route.value: Apply with an honours first degree at 2.1 or the overseas equivalent.
entry_route.quote: A good first degree with Honours at 2.1 (UK) or the overseas equivalent.

toefl_min.value: The School requires Profile 3-D: TOEFL iBT 5.0 overall for 2026 onwards, with 4.5 in each skill.

also.quote: The English language requirements for our postgraduate research programmes are Profile 3-D.

ielts_min.value: The School requires IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with 6.5 in each component (Profile 3-D).
ielts_min.quote: IELTS Academic (including IELTS One Skill retake) 7.0 6.5 6.5 6.5 6.5

also.quote: The English language requirements for our postgraduate research programmes are Profile 3-D.

notes: The School's own research English profile (3-D) is higher than the university's 7-D; it overrides the university values here. No separate data science PhD is listed.
